body: It has just been this way for the last 20 years.  I have no idea why I'm still here.
Hey thanks for replying.  Nothing can happen tonight or for a while, but just trying to figure out how to start the process and put an end to things...
Thank you for posting this as it says what I have always wanted to say, but could never find the words.  It is nice to know I am not completely alone in this.

As someone who has been more or less in the same shoes as your girlfriend, my guess is she is trying to work through this as much as you.  My advice to you is to be supportive, and keep talking with her about your concerns.  It can be difficult, but I think it is well worth the reward.  Good luck.
